study type: Retrospective study for model development and validation
cohort: The study included 437 patients with placenta previa who delivered babies between January 2012 and December 2018, with additional patients used for external validation.
finding: The developed model, based on independent risk factors including NLR, timing of cesarean section and miscarriage, placenta previa type, placental lacunae, and uterovesical hypervascularity, effectively predicted PAS among women with placenta previa, showing an AUC of 0.821, sensitivity of 80.6%, and specificity of 68.9%.
